notes.title: Our new game ‘Kaichu’ is out now!
notes.notes:
Announcing the release of our new game…
[b]Kaichu - The Kaiju Dating Sim[/b]

[previewyoutube=8kLvoXYXxTk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]KAIJU ROMANCE[/b]
Kaichu is a dating sim about kaiju! You play the role of Gigachu, a gigantic romantic looking for love. Meet six other eligible kaiju and visit twenty-four famous landmarks where Gigachu will answer challenging compatibility questions to decide the fate of your relationship.

notes.title: Bounce from one mortal peril to another in Merrily Perilly
notes.notes:
Ever been poisoned without healing or a cure potion in an RPG? Prompting a mad dash into danger to find something – anything – that will prolong your life just a few moments longer? Upcoming comedy adventure Merrily Perilly is about this kind of looming peril writ large, with you leading bumbling protagonist Perry from one impending doom to the next, with each successive fix being more dangerous than the ailment that got you there in the first place.
